pack.title: Unsolicited advice
pack.description: Ask for listening instead of advice.

scenarios.setting: You tell a friend about a problem and they begin prescribing solutions.
scenarios.jab: What you need to do is quit immediately.
scenarios.goal: Ask for listening instead of advice.

replies.line: I'm looking for a listener right now, rather than solutions.
replies.why: It states the kind of support you want without rejecting the friendship.
replies.delivery: Make “listen” the key word; keep your tone inviting rather than dismissive.

replies.line: Listen first, please. No fixes yet.
replies.why: It gives a short, actionable request for the conversation.
replies.delivery: Make “listen” the key word; keep your tone inviting rather than dismissive.

replies.line: I know you want to help; could you listen while I work through how I feel?
replies.why: It acknowledges their intention while directing them to useful support.
replies.delivery: Make “listen” the key word; keep your tone inviting rather than dismissive.

replies.line: The troubleshooting department is closed; listening is open.
replies.why: The playful distinction makes your requested support easy to remember.
replies.delivery: Make “listen” the key word; keep your tone inviting rather than dismissive.

followUp.line: I may ask for ideas later; right now, being heard would help.
followUp.why: It preserves the possibility of advice without giving up your current need.
followUp.delivery: Pause before “I may ask for ideas later,” keep the volume even, then allow an answer without reopening your decision.
